name: DoIT listed data center & cloud service providers roster
developer: Department of Information Technology (DoIT), Government of Nepal
notes: National roster under the Data Center and Cloud Service (Operation and Management) Directives 2081; verified listed providers: Ncell Axiata Ltd; Access World Tech Pvt. Ltd; Silver Lining Pvt. Ltd; Data Hub Pvt. Ltd; Dish Media Network Ltd; Digital Network Solution/Everest Cloud (cloud-only, not a physical DC); Times Global Pvt Ltd. Roster is A-grade provider evidence, NOT a facility count; Access World/Silver Lining/Dish Media/Times Global lack captured physical-site proof (U).

name: IDMC / Government Integrated Data Center (GIDC), Kathmandu
notes: Current government data-center operator route (Bagmati/Kathmandu Valley) for government domain/VM/VPS/colocation/backup; Bagmati province source confirms citizen data hosted on GIDC and the Hetauda DRC. A for government service page; facility size not published.

name: Hetauda Disaster Recovery Center (DRC for GIDC)
notes: Backup for GIDC in Hetauda (Bagmati); came into operation May 2019 per The Himalayan Times; KOICA-built per ICT Frame. A/B: government context A, inauguration/cost details B (press).

name: Ncell Integrated Data Center (IDC), Nakkhu, Lalitpur
notes: 250-rack IDC in Nakkhu, Lalitpur (Bagmati); ANSI/TIA-942-C Rated 3 (Tier III) Design & Constructed Facility Certification announced June 2026 (press; certifier list not captured -> certification detail B); earthquake-resistant to ~9 Richter; Ncell also runs DR centers in Pokhara (Gandaki) and Hetauda (Bagmati) per local press. A for operator page + DoIT listing.

name: DataHub Kathmandu data center
notes: Nepal's first private data center (Bagmati/Kathmandu Valley); part of dual-Kathmandu/Butwal network with Yeti Cloud and YetiCloud.ai AI cloud (Hosted AI partnership per DCD/TechSansar, launch timing B); DoIT-listed. A for operator-owned facts.

name: DataHub Butwal data center (Tilottama)
notes: Butwal (Lumbini) facility in operation since 2015; single-storey earthquake-resilient building meeting Seismic Zone V standards per operator page. A for operator-owned facts.

name: WorldLink Data World data center (Chandragiri, Kathmandu)
notes: Launched Feb 2025 in Chandragiri (Bagmati); 3.5 MW IT power, 520 racks, near NEA Mata Tirtha substation; marketed as Nepal's first Tier-3/Edge-certified green facility (certifier not identified -> certification claim U/B). B from trade press until operator-primary page captured.

name: Cloud Himalaya data center (Thapathali, Kathmandu)
notes: Colocation/cloud provider at Central Business Park, Thapathali (Bagmati), since 2013 with 99.995% uptime claim; 'Tier-4' marketing unverified by Uptime Institute/TIA (U/B); third-party guide mentions a claimed Tilottama DR. A for operator-owned existence; Tier claims U.

name: Nepal Telecom data centers (Kathmandu primary + Bhairahawa DR)
notes: Huawei LOI/bid approval Jan 2025 (NPR 484M / ~USD 3.5M) for primary DC in Kathmandu (Bagmati) and DR center 265 km away in Bhairahawa (Lumbini); physical infrastructure by Huawei. B (trade press) until NTC/PPMO/e-GP award documents captured.

name: Sovereign AI Compute Center (Syuchatar, Kathmandu)
notes: Announced in FY 2083/84 budget speech (FM Swarnim Wagle): Nepal's first sovereign AI compute center at Syuchatar, Kathmandu (Bagmati), with AI processing units offered to startups at concessional rates; feasibility/risks under scrutiny (NepalNews). Planned/announced until procurement/construction evidence (A only if MoF budget text captured).

name: Kohalpur government data center (Lumbini)
notes: FY 2082/83 budget line for Kohalpur (Banke, Lumbini) data-center construction/upgrade per methodology-verified summaries (TechSansar route); no dedicated article URL captured this run - budget-highlights summary cited instead; facility details U. Planned until tender/construction evidence.

name: Nepal Electricity Authority data center (Kathmandu)
notes: NEA launched a Kathmandu data center per DCD; NEA internal DC also referenced by Nepali Times (Nagarjun base). B from trade press; U/C until NEA primary evidence.

name: Yotta / BLC Holding 4 MW data center (Kathmandu)
developer: Yotta Infrastructure (Hiranandani) + BLC Holding Pvt Ltd
notes: April announcement per DCD of a planned 4 MW data center in Kathmandu by Indian operator Yotta and Nepalese conglomerate BLC Holding; no site/permits captured. B lead.

name: Vianet data center (Central Business Park, Kathmandu)
notes: Physical facility lead from fire/outage incident reporting (NepaliTelecom coverage per methodology); exact address/capacity U/C; methodology seed, no operator-primary page captured this run. C.
